'''Rewello''' was a [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived around the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. Rewello was an accomplished mime and comedian, having performed for the [[Regent of Alderaan]]. He was known to have entertained his niece, [[Hart-and-Parn Gorra-Fiolla]], with tales of show business.
